title: DVB-T 8k: one transmitter and two echoes
description: A DVB-T 8k GI 1/4 signal on 600.95 MHz (real TPS, cell ID), the 2.4 MHz VFO 0.95 MHz off the channel centre, 3 s looped: the direct path from 30 deg, copies 37 us later from 150 deg (-4 dB) and 112 us from 260 deg (-10 dB). Path separation on. Expect the TPS facts and three Path talkers at those bearings.
